summary: Endeavour Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K on August 24, 2026, attaching a press release dated August 23, 2026, announcing the removal of a blockade at its Terronera Mine in Mexico and the resumption of operations on August 24, 2026. The company is working with the Ejido community to ensure long-term stability. This is an operational update, not a special-situation corporate event. No deal terms, prices, premiums, or strategic actions are stated. The filing is routine and does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, capital changes, or management transitions.
